0.1dB is a numerical convergence guide, not a paper reproduction acceptance threshold

acceptance.ber_consistency: abs(mean frame BER difference)<=max(3 counting-SE,3 frame-mean SE)

plan.execution: Run selected cases explicitly; no propagation occurs in dry-run.

receiver.policy: dedicated qualification pilots; preliminary window selected on dedicated pilot scored data, never production/test
